name: xmip
description: Validates an Xmip node configuration through the runtime itself, as you edit it.

xmip.server.path.description: The xmip-lsp executable: a name on PATH or a full path. After a cargo build of xmip-core-gui-vscode it is target/debug/xmip-lsp.

xmip.runtime.library.description: The runtime's native library (xmip_core_runtime.dll, .so or .dylib) that validates the configuration. Empty means the server's own lookup: the XMIP_RUNTIME_LIBRARY variable, then the library beside the server.
